classification: research evidence for a retained candidate; not final performance certification, production deployment, public API, or compatibility commitment
purpose: bind the source delta and ten historical M2 runs behind the published timing and short-window traffic-equivalence claims

members.role: binary Git patch from base commit to the exact H1 Rust/Cargo build source used by the parent arms
binary Git patch from base commit to the exact M2 Rust/Cargo build source
binary Git patch from reconstructed H1 to the exact M2 Rust/Cargo build source

h1_build_source_manifest.algorithm: sorted build-source records: lowercase SHA-256, TAB, raw byte count, TAB, slash-separated relative path, LF; manifest UTF-8 without BOM

build_source_manifest.algorithm: sorted build-source records: lowercase SHA-256, TAB, raw byte count, TAB, slash-separated relative path, LF; manifest UTF-8 without BOM

h1_reconstruction.boundary: the committed parent patch retains the exact H1 Rust/Cargo build source; the historical full H1 patch contains non-Rust research drivers and is used only outside the repository as reconstruction lineage

raw_representation_alignment.method: when H1 reconstructed text and M2 text are identical after CRLF/lone-CR to LF comparison, restore the M2 raw bytes before freezing H1; this preserves inherited line endings without hiding semantic changes

m2.name: harness-m2.exe
m2.role: same binary for direct and skip arms

h1_parent.name: harness-parent.exe
h1_parent.role: frozen H1 binary for parent versus skip arms

binaries.retention: binary files remain author-local; their immutable identities are retained here, while the committed cumulative source patch provides portable source review and exact raw-byte replay

ten_k.retention: the original 10k fixture remains author-local and is not promised as a project-controlled durable artifact; the pair is supplemental to the 100k comparisons

external_driver.role: historical Windows run orchestration only; no non-Rust program enters the repository

runs.execution_identity_note: short-prefix did not emit execution_id; group/order, exact binary, plan, configuration, process envelope, and complete output-tree identity bind the run

LF707_BARRIER.driver_action: remove LF707_BARRIER before launching the frozen H1 parent binary

process.memory_boundary: 250ms polling of process high-water counters; final tail may be missed

source_tree.manifest_rule: UTF-8 lines: relative path, TAB, byte count, TAB, lowercase SHA-256, LF; entries follow ascending PowerShell Sort-Object FullName order

retained.timing_boundary: iteration=advance+buffered semantic output; extended quality, profile CSV, final flush and checkpoints excluded

timing.method: tick >= 65; n=192; p95 linearly interpolates at (n-1)*0.95; stddev uses sample denominator n-1

resource_boundary.boundary: outside iteration/Core timing; cumulative same-zone multi-owner exposure, not geometric collision certification; initial in-zone occupancy may be left-censored

traffic_equivalence.boundary: byte equality covers the measured 256-tick short windows; it is not long-wait, signal-ETA, full-day, or final traffic certification

retention.promise: the committed envelope is the durable evidence for the stated M2 claims; retrieval of author-local originals is not promised

limitations: short-prefix emitted no harness execution_id; ordered evidence ids plus exact binary, input, configuration, process, and complete output-tree identities bind each run

the binary artifacts were not promoted to a project-controlled release; committed H1 and M2 source patches replay both exact Rust/Cargo build-source trees but do not claim bit-reproducible MSVC output
the ten runs did not record a full independent machine-state snapshot beyond the retained power, WPR-idle, process, and driver evidence
these short runs support candidate retention and source review; they do not establish final product performance or replace later certification
